items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And Leon Washington, the saxophone player that used to be with me, he worked in Fats' band one time, one of the big bands.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he had this -- and then it seemed like certain guys -- Art seemed to be like that, they never wanted to be alone, they always wanted somebody around them or with them. And Leon Washington, the saxophone player that used to be with me, he worked in Fats' band one time, one of the big bands. And so when he came to Chicago -- I think he was around here...
